title: The masthead sits on the page ground on every page: the card and its shadow deleted, the nav pills replaced by Ubuntu text links with orange hover and active, as on Delvehold; the brand doc amended
first: Map: docs/masthead-campaign.md r2, sections 'The operator's words', 'Rulings in force', 'Body facts' B1-B5 and B9, 'The shape' > 'The masthead without the card' and 'The nav', 'The authority map'. The operator's words, verbatim: 'no card site-wide and let's get rid of those overused pill buttons while we're at it' and 'Ubuntu text links with brand orange hover, we've already done this with the Delvehold site'.

Rulings in force: operator-ground-behind-masthead, operator-no-card-no-pills, operator-nav-ubuntu-links, self-masthead-pills-first (masthead pills only; .gamecult-repo-link and .gamecult-action are not touched here). No question is open for this cut; scrollbar-fix-home is deferred and is not in this cut.

deck-page-fixes (thing campaign) landed at 8fb3dff and 90c2d94, so this cut has no dependency; the line numbers below are read from 90c2d94. That cut grew the body[data-slug="Thing"] block (1148-) by 34 lines, which is why the $mobile numbers differ from r1. If main moves again before Hands starts, re-read by selector.

Precedent: Delvehold c43d504, site/quartz/styles/custom.scss:115-131 (.delvehold-nav: flex wrap, gap 0.4rem 1.2rem; a { color: var(--darkgray); font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap }; a:hover, a.active { color: accent }) and site/quartz/components/DelveholdMasthead.tsx:27-32 (class active and aria-current="page" on the active route). Two substitutions, both ruled: font-family var(--bodyFont) (Ubuntu) for Delvehold's header font, and var(--secondary) #ff8a2a for Delvehold's purple. Ubuntu 500 is loaded (site/quartz.config.ts:36). Delvehold does not set text-decoration; the engine's base a rule has it none, so this cut does not set it either.

Brand sources are canonical: site/quartz.config.ts configuration.theme (body Ubuntu 300 400 500 700; secondary #ff8a2a, tertiary #59b7ff, darkgray #b7c7d9, dark #eef5ff) and custom.scss. The brand doc docs/brand-design-language.md is a guide and is amended by this cut because it will otherwise be silent on a decision the operator made.

The masthead component is site/quartz/components/GameCultMasthead.tsx; the nav anchor is rendered at lines 181-188 with class gamecult-nav-chip (active appended) at 184 and target/rel for external routes at 185-186. The engine's Header.css sets header { display:flex; align-items:center; margin:2rem 0; gap:1.5rem }, which the site must still beat for the masthead with display:block and its own margin.
Deploy is push to main -> workflow 'Deploy Quartz' -> GitHub Pages at gamecult.org; small commits; CI is the verifier. A local .\scripts\quartz\quartz.ps1 build is optional on Starfire.

deletes.note: Lines 646-665, the masthead card: position, align-items, padding, border, border-radius 22px, the radial+linear background, box-shadow, overflow are deleted. The rule survives as two declarations only: display: block; margin: 0 0 1.2rem (what beats the engine's header rule).
Lines 730-751, .gamecult-nav-chip and its :hover/.active rule: deleted whole (999px radius, sky border and fill, Montserrat 300, orange hover fill). Replaced by the .gamecult-nav-link rules in adds.
The $mobile card padding rule, .page > #quartz-body .center > .page-header > header { padding: 0.95rem 0.95rem 1rem } (1473-1475): deleted; there is no card to pad.

keeps_moves: The masthead's structure and content are unchanged: title, tagline, community links (Patreon wordmark, GitHub, Discord with their sky glow), the nine routes, their external target/rel, and pickActiveRoute. Only the nav anchor's class and aria, and the surrounding styles, change.

.gamecult-titlebar, -top, -copy, -title, -tagline, -nav, -community, -wordmark and -icon rules (custom.scss 667-721, 753-811) and their $mobile variants are unchanged. .gamecult-titlebar-links (722-728) keeps its rule; only its gap changes.
The page-header margin-top rules (638, 1469) are unchanged; the masthead's distance from the top of the page is theirs.
The ritual-paper essays, the colossus post, Graph, Thing, tour and Pitch keep their slug blocks; none of them styled the card or the chips, so none changes here.
.gamecult-repo-link (960) and .gamecult-action (2206) keep their pill recipe under self-masthead-pills-first.
adds: GameCultMasthead.tsx line 184: class becomes gamecult-nav-link (active appended as before), and the anchor carries aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}. No other change to the component.
custom.scss 722-728: .gamecult-titlebar-links gap becomes 0.4rem 1.2rem (Delvehold's); display, flex-wrap, min-width, align-items stay.

custom.scss, where the chip rules were (730-751): .gamecult-nav-link { color: var(--darkgray); font-family: var(--bodyFont); font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; } .gamecult-nav-link:hover, .gamecult-nav-link:focus-visible, .gamecult-nav-link.active { color: var(--secondary); } Nothing else: no padding, border, radius, fill, underline, transform or ::after.
custom.scss 646: the surviving header rule reads .page > #quartz-body .center > .page-header > header { display: block; margin: 0 0 1.2rem; } and nothing else.

docs/brand-design-language.md, a new section '## Masthead' inserted before the '## Ritual Paper' heading (line 86, after the Palette section's closing paragraph): the masthead sits directly on the page ground on every page, no card, border, radius or shadow; the nav is Ubuntu 500 at 0.92rem in --darkgray, hover and active in the orange accent and nothing else (no rule, fill or underline), after the Delvehold site's nav; the active route also carries aria-current="page"; the title stays Montserrat 200 uppercase tracked. Six to ten lines; reference the rules by selector, not line number. The 'Written' line (15) gains ', revised 2026-10-02'.

file_changes.change: the card rule reduced to display: block; margin: 0 0 1.2rem.
.gamecult-titlebar-links gap becomes 0.4rem 1.2rem; the .gamecult-nav-chip rules are replaced by the .gamecult-nav-link rules.
class gamecult-nav-link (+ active); aria-current="page" on the active route.
new '## Masthead' section inserted before '## Ritual Paper'; the 'Written' line (15) dated.

authority_map.owner: custom.scss owns the masthead's look: one header rule that beats the engine's, the .gamecult-titlebar* rules and the .gamecult-nav-link rules. GameCultMasthead.tsx owns the masthead's content and the active route. The page's own ground (the body wash, a scoped variant's wash, the Thing hero) owns what is behind the masthead; the masthead paints none.
inputs: the route list and the current slug (GameCultMasthead.tsx)
outputs: one masthead DOM on every page with <a class="gamecult-nav-link"> routes and aria-current="page" on the active one
the masthead's type sitting on the page ground on /, /Projects, /Blog/*, the three ritual-paper essays, /Graph, the colossus post and /Thing
derived_state: the active route, derived from the slug by pickActiveRoute (unchanged); its only marks are the active class and aria-current, both set in the component
the hover and active colour, derived from --secondary; no second orange is written
forbidden_writers: no rule paints a background, border, border-radius or box-shadow on .page-header > header or on .gamecult-titlebar
no gamecult-nav-chip class in the component or the stylesheet; no radius, border, fill, padding, underline or ::after in the .gamecult-nav-link rules
no slug-scoped masthead variant: every page gets the one masthead
no engine edit (Header.tsx keeps its bare header rule; the site beats it with display:block and margin; the base a rule supplies text-decoration none)
no change to .gamecult-repo-link or .gamecult-action under self-masthead-pills-first
no scrollbar fix (html width) in this cut; scrollbar-fix-home is deferred
shared_paths: every page renders the one GameCultMasthead through the engine's Header
the same Deploy Quartz workflow and Pages origin
authority_map.deletion_line: the card declarations (646-665), the mobile card padding (1473-1475) and the chip rules (730-751) are deleted in the first commit, with the component's class rename in the same commit, before the .gamecult-nav-link rules and the brand doc section are written.
